snapshot: Middle East de-escalation is collapsing geopolitical risk premiums across energy and duration simultaneously, forcing rapid capital reallocation from commodities and defense into equities before fundamental repricing catches up.

Compute consolidation around vertically integrated incumbents (Meta, SpaceX, Google) is strangling pure-play AI startups while closing infrastructure moats, bifurcating capital markets between sovereign-grade regulated platforms and structurally underfunded frontier labs.

US-China tech decoupling and bifurcating capital flows are creating margin compression across AI-dependent sectors while favoring defensive industrial and financial services names that no longer compete for scarce allocator capital.
themes: Capital allocation cascade and reallocation velocity
Geopolitical risk pricing and energy market repricing
Tech bifurcation: incumbent consolidation versus startup scarcity
Fixed income volatility and equity duration disconnect
De-risking toward infrastructure and tokenized RWAs
